title: Tart Polish Cucumber Cake
description: Moist and refreshing Polish-style cake featuring cucumber, perfect for warm weather dinner parties. Easy to make and impressive to serve.
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, cocoa powder, lemon zest, and a pinch of salt.
In a large bowl, using an electric mixer, beat the butter until creamy.
Gradually add the dry ingredients to the butter mixture, beating until a smooth batter forms.
Pour the batter into a greased 9-inch springform pan.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Let the cake cool in the pan for 10 minutes before transferring it to a wire rack to cool completely.
Dust with powdered sugar before serving.
